title: CutRight v2 eval case file
description: A per-skill collection of statically checkable eval cases adapted from workspace-capabilities evals. Enforced by tools/v2-evals/run.py (stdlib checks; this document is the normative shape).

skill.description: CutRight skill directory name these cases belong to.

source_file.description: Repo-relative path of the workspace evals.json the cases were adapted from.

adapted.description: Cases were rewritten to CutRight inputs/outputs; no upstream text was copied.

omitted_cases.description: Upstream case ids deliberately not adapted; each gets an exclusion note.

skill.description: Required when status is routed: the skill the request routes to.

reason_code.description: Required when status is refused or degraded. Stable codes: skill_boundary, approval_gate, verification_gate, fabrication_refusal, provider_gate, no_cloud_provider, brand_gate, pipeline_boundary.

evidence.description: Typed evidence records the run must emit (e.g. AssetDelivery, VisualReviewResult).

source_cases.description: Upstream case ids this case was adapted from.
